[[The Leviathan]] is a giant [[wurm]] found in the area with the [[Aspect of Shadows]] inside [[The Deep]]. It can fire a powerful projectile attack that does high damage, often 300 damage or more.

In addition to the [[environmental effect]] of not being able to cast [[enchantments]] in most of the area, the Leviathan will be surrounded by several [[Reborn Irukandji]] which will keep placing the Spirit of [[Disenchantment]] making [[Protection Prayers]] and other protective enchantments nearly useless.

Upon approaching it, the Leviathan will be encased in jade, but will break free as soon as players come close enough.

==Missions==
*[[The Jade Sea]]
**{{NPC location|The Deep}}

==Notes==
*Unlike most wurms, the Leviathan has a centipede-like appearance.
*Several [[Petrified leviathan|Leviathans encased in Jade]] can be found throughout the Jade Sea, such as behind [[Incetol, Devout of Depths]] and across the bridge where the Oni are in [[Rhea's Crater]] and near the exit leading from [[Leviathan Pits]] to [[Gyala Hatchery]].

==Trivia==
*This is the largest [[Cantha]]n creature. 
*The Leviathan is a possible reference to the mythological [[w:Leviathan|sea monster]] from the Old Testament.
